headlines.title: Is Costco open on Columbus Day?
headlines.summary: It’s a constant juggling act on Costco’s part to decide when to stay open and when to close.

headlines.title: What Are Costco Investors Betting On?
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) stock currently trades at 45.3 times its earnings of the past twelve months. At first glance, that valuation looks steep for a retailer that keeps about 3% of its sales as net profit. Investors, however, are buying the years ahead rather than a single past year of performance. So how much growth is a buyer at this price paying for.

headlines.title: Costco sales rise in September as strong traffic drives start to fiscal 2027
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ:COST, XETRA:CTO) reported September net sales of about $30 billion, up 13% year on year, marking a strong start to financial year 2027, according to Jefferies. Total comparable sales rose 11.

headlines.title: Prediction: Wall Street's Next Blockbuster Stock Split Will Come From This Retailer
headlines.summary: It's been 26 years since a company you know has declared a stock split. It's time to change that.

headlines.title: Costco's September Sales Rise 13% on Strong Comps, Digital Growth
headlines.summary: COST's September sales rose 13% to $30.02 billion, fueled by strong comparable sales across regions and 19% digital growth, reinforcing its retail momentum.

description: Costco Wholesale Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of membership warehouses in the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Iceland, New Zealand, and Sweden. It offers merchandise, including sundries, dry groceries, candies, coolers, freezers, deli, liquor, and tobacco; non-food merchandise comprising appliances, small electronics, health and beauty aids, hardware, lawn and garden, sporting goods, tires, toys and seasonal, automotive, stamps, tickets, apparel, furniture, domestics, housewares, special order kiosks, and jewelry; and fresh food, such as meat, produce, service deli, and bakery products. The company is also involved in warehouse ancillary operations, which include gasoline, pharmacies, optical, food courts, hearing-aid centers, and tire installation centers. In addition, it engages in e-commerce, business centers, travel, and other businesses. The company was formerly known as Costco Companies, Inc. and changed its name to Costco Wholesale Corporation in August 1999. Costco Wholesale Corporation was founded in 1976 and is based in Issaquah, Washington.
